{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.20","title":"radio.py: live apply_all None does not pop stash; GE re-apply can resurrect","description":"## Problem

9098.13 closed on re-running `ChaosEngine.apply_all` at re-inject so post-TxEnd Drop/Jam/Partition work. Two remaining holes in that re-apply:

1. **Live drop does not pop the stash.** In `_get_rx_result_internal`, `apply_all` returning None is `continue` with no `delayed_map.pop`. If the TX is still in-flight, that txid is then absent from `present_ids`, so `_reinject_delayed_candidates` runs `apply_all` again on the pre-chaos original.

2. **GilbertElliottRule is not idempotent.** Unlike `LossRule` (cached per tx_id), `GilbertElliottRule.apply` transitions the per-link Markov chain and rolls loss on every call (`lora_medium/chaos.py`). Stash-time `apply_all` already transitioned once. Every later live poll transitions again. If live drops, re-inject transitions a third time and may return the candidate. If `current < expire_us`, re-inject then `continue` **without popping**, so a live drop is undone for the delayed path. At expire, `apply_all` runs yet again.

Deterministic Drop/Jammer/Partition still drop on the second apply (13's tests). LossRule's cache makes the second draw match the first. Gilbert-Elliott (and any future stateful rule) can resurrect a dropped delayed frame or see 2N extra transitions vs one decision at first hearing.

13's design said: "or be dropped if a later live apply_all returned None for that txid. If apply_all returns None, pop the stash entry." Only the re-inject None path pops today.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (`_get_rx_result_internal` live `if result is None: continue` ~L529-530; `_reinject_delayed_candidates` re-apply ~L461-472)
- lora_medium GilbertElliottRule.apply (stateful; LossRule is cached)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py (Drop/Jam/Partition after TxEnd only; no GE, no live-drop-during-airtime)

## Why this is correctness

Chaos composition with LatencyRule is supposed to be one decision per hearing, then delay. Re-apply is required so rules added after TxEnd still bite (13). It is not required to re-sample a stateful loss model or to keep a stash after a live drop already returned None.
","design":"On live apply_all None, pop `(node_id, tx.id)` immediately (13's fail-closed). Do not call GilbertElliottRule.apply again on re-inject for a tx_id already evaluated (cache like LossRule, or skip stateful rules on the delayed path). A live drop must not be reversible at expire.
